about: A sample of real KARDS cards (official card data, game version 53) encoded in the Stage 3 card schema (SPEC 1.5). Paraphrases are functional summaries in our own words, not the card text. Each entry has an 'encoding' (a card dict the loader accepts) or 'unsupported' (the missing primitives, keys of unsupported_vocabulary). tests/test_kards_sample.py parses every encoding and recomputes 'coverage'.

mapping.kind: infantry -> troop, tank -> fast, artillery -> ranged; fighter/bomber -> ranged (aircraft strike any line from the support line: the ranged reach) with tag 'air'; order -> operation; countermeasure -> unsupported
mapping.stats: kredits -> cost, attack -> attack, defense -> health, operation cost -> move_cost
mapping.keywords: Guard -> defense, Heavy Armor X -> armor X, Blitz / Smokescreen / Ambush / Fury / Shock -> the trait of the same name; Exile (deck building only) -> tag 'exile'
mapping.tags: the KARDS kind, 'air' for aircraft, and the nation (lower case)

countermeasure.description: Countermeasures: hidden armed cards that fire on the opponent's turn and can cancel effects.

cost_modifier.description: Cost modifiers for cards in hand.

delayed_or_granted_effect.description: Delayed or granted effects, and durations beyond "turn" (e.g. 'while this is in play', 'at the end of your turn, destroy it').

copy_or_random_card.description: Copies of cards and random card generation.

deck_manipulation.description: Deck manipulation: dig, shuffle into a deck, tutor.

damage_modifier.description: Damage modifiers (double damage, +1 damage, reduced damage).

take_control_or_remove.description: Taking control of a unit, or removing it from play without destroying it.

set_stat.description: Setting a stat to a value.

rule_modifier.description: Global rule modifiers and per-unit rule exceptions (cannot be targeted, cannot attack the HQ, HQs cannot gain defense, deployment effects do not trigger).

develop.description: Develop (choose one of several generated cards).

play_restriction.description: Conditions that restrict playing or deploying a card.

per_unit_history.description: Conditions on one unit's own history (was it attacked last turn, how often has this trigger fired).

new_trigger.description: Triggers the schema lacks: a player draws, a unit damages an HQ, a unit is targeted by an order.

amount_difference.description: Amounts that subtract two quantities (e.g. draw up to the opponent's hand size).

per_target_amount.description: Amounts evaluated separately for each target (e.g. each unit takes damage equal to its own operation cost).

conditional_repeat.description: Repetition whose count is decided during resolution (repeat while the last pass destroyed a unit, once per unit destroyed).

position_placement.description: Putting units into a specific board position (next to this unit).

refresh_unit.description: Letting a unit operate (move/attack) again in the same turn.

splash_after_death.description: 'Target and adjacent units' splash that must still reach the neighbours after the main target died (SPEC 2.13 known limitation).

fight.description: A unit fights another unit outside an attack (a combat exchange as if it attacked).

hand_position.description: Effects that depend on a card's position in the hand.

token_sources.i16_ishak: https://herokuapi.kards.com/graphql (cards query behind https://www.kards.com/cards, cardId=i16_ishak): Soviet fighter, 2 kredits, operation cost 1, 2/2, no rules text.
